newsitem.title: USA: Premiere plans $125 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: Premiere plans $125 mln private placement.

text.p: Premiere Technologies Inc said Monday that it intends, subject to market and other conditions, to raise $125 million through a private offering of convertible subordinated notes, carrying a seven-year term.

The company said it intends to use the proceeds of the offering for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures, working capital, and the possible acquisition of complementary businesses, products and technologies, none of which has yet been identified.
